text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research paper focused on land use prediction at the national scale for Cambodia. It explicitly implements a spatially-explicit land system change model (CLUMondo) at 1000m resolution covering the entire country. The paper develops and compares three future scenarios of large-scale land acquisition (LSLA) governance policies up to 2040, quantitatively simulating land system changes and their impacts on tree cover, natural areas, and potential tiger reintroduction habitats. The study provides mapped LULC projections under different scenarios, includes quantitative results on land cover change, scenario comparisons, and discusses model suitability and scenario assumptions. It is not a review article, not a purely ecological/species study, nor a methodological or single-scenario study, and it meets all core inclusion criteria for national-scale spatial LULC prediction with multiple scenarios and quantitative outputs.)
